title: Robust Control-Variate Design When Pilots Leave Cross-World Dependence Unidentified
banked_reason: D0.5 delivered a mathematically sound subfield result below the required field floor; no faithful same-topic field-level repair remains under the current assumptions.
gap_reasons: The stability price is only defined as b_n^st = min_{B in K_n^st} w+(B) - inf_{B in B_Z+} w+(B) >= 0, with no rate.
The projector lemma supplies only fixed-n qualitative sequences and contains no modulus involving loss error, the positive spectral margin, the coordinate envelope, or n.
Selector-wide observable improvement fails already at the center triangle instance: another lawful stable minimax tie representative reverses the observable gap.
No faithful same-topic field-level repair exists without a new crux-encoding approximation or tie-selection premise.
proof_attempt_summary: The derivation proved the sharp Frechet endpoint reduction, rank-stratified certification, measurable and encoded-input selectors, directed-local observable bridges, and a stable all-rank selector with explicit deployment price. The attempted field-level closure failed because the current assumptions provide no triangular-sequence approximation rate for that stability price, while an exact lawful stable minimax tie representative reverses the desired selector-wide observable gap. The resulting mathematics is sound and reusable at subfield tier; a field-tier revival needs genuinely new approximation or tie-selection primitives.
tldr: An unpaired pilot identifies the two potential-outcome marginals but not their cross-world copula.  The note converts the sharp Fr\'echet covariance interval into an endpoint maximum for Zhao's affine residual-variance criterion, solves the regular rank-two problem with finite exact-input certificates, and treats Zhao's full all-rank pseudoinverse carrier through a measurable arbitrary-real selector and a separate exact-input cylindrical-algebraic selector.  A compact stable all-rank carrier makes observable deployment auditable: its regret relative to the unrestricted value is bounded by the exact stability price \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\), pilot error, optimization tolerance, and the selected-rank variance bridge.  The triangle witness proves an exact robust reduction of \(4912/39525\) in the basis objective and a positive observable variance gap for one displayed pair of tie representatives; no universal strictness or free stability is claimed.
gap: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates explicitly leaves robust basis choice under moment misspecification open; existing Fréchet results identify covariance endpoints, and existing global-optimization results certify Euclidean-box programs, but no paper joins these steps for a block-separable network basis with projective symmetry.
fill: The project imports the sharp endpoint formulas, proves their affine worst-copula and zero-surrogate frontier inside Zhao's fixed-basis objective, formulates a computably specified global maximin certificate on the compact \(\kappa\)-regular projective class, and proves uniform plug-in value and outer argmax-correspondence consistency. Conditional persistence is supporting: a strict-dominance region requires a separate certified witness with both separation and optimizer-wide \(\kappa\)-slack.
